scope: Selected effective image dictionary, default-Decode, alternate-image, and inline-image dictionary cells; not whole-clause or codec certification.

source.standard: ISO 32000-2:2020 as amended by EC3; footers checked in primary PDF.

tables.caption: Additional entries specific to an image dictionary

selected_cells.condition: Optional name; if present, shall be XObject.
Name; required for ordinary image XObjects (except when used solely as thumbnail); value shall be Image.
Positive integer, required; image sample width.
Positive integer, required; image sample height.
Required except JPXDecode; not for ImageMask; JPX dictionary space overrides codestream, absent dictionary space uses codestream; absent-space Decode ignored except ImageMask.
Permitted values 1,2,4,8,16 (16 since PDF1.5); shared component depth; optional on masks and JPX; stencil if present is 1; filter-output consistency applies.
Optional rendering intent, default current graphics-state intent; ignored for stencil.
Optional boolean, default false; true selects stencil; sample paint uses current nonstroking color; BPC and Decode restrictions apply.
Optional stream or color-key array; absent by default; forbidden on ImageMask.
Optional numeric pairs, default per Table88; pair count is twice components, except mask [0 1] or [1 0]; JPX/no ColorSpace exception.
Optional boolean, default false; request is a hint that may be ignored.
Optional array, cannot occur on an alternate image; effective selection amended by EC3 #79.
Optional soft-mask image; overrides graphics-state SMask and image Mask; EC3 #215 says ignore this entry if nonzero SMaskInData is also present.
Optional integer for JPX, otherwise meaningless; default 0; 1 carries opacity, 2 carries opacity with premultiplied color; nonzero conflicts with SMask and has one shared opacity channel.
Required only in PDF1.0, optional afterwards, deprecated PDF2.0 by EC3 #619.
Required only if image is a structural content item.
Optional byte string, preferred indirect; Web Capture parent-set identifier.
Optional dictionary, deprecated in PDF2.0; ignored when ImageMask is true.
Optional metadata stream; see §14.3.2.
Optional OCG/OCMD. Before processing an image XObject, visibility shall be determined; invisible means skip the entire image as if no Do occurred.
Optional PDF2 array of one or more FileSpec dictionaries associated with this image XObject; §14.13.7.
Optional PDF2 measure dictionary specifying the scale and units applying to the image.
Optional PDF2 point-data dictionary specifying extended geospatial data applying to the image.

tables.caption: Entries in an alternate image dictionary
rows: DefaultForPrinting optional boolean default false, at most one designated per base
tables.selection_algorithm: Effective §8.9.5.4 algorithm includes the EC3 2020 markup note and #79 corrections.

tables.caption: Entries in an inline image object
tables.rule: Unlisted entries ignored; abbreviation precedence is corrected by #3; uppercase I key is #306.

tables.caption: Additional abbreviations in an inline image object
tables.rule: Abbreviations are inline-only; JPXDecode, Crypt and JBIG2Decode prohibited for inline data.

ec3.effect: Abbreviation wins over full spelling even when the full spelling appears later.
Table87 marked-key restriction for soft-mask images points to Table143; it is not a separate generic image error rule.
Emphasis on Mask wording; no substantive requirement change.
DeviceGray/RGB/CMYK names identify device spaces directly, not same-named ColorSpace resources.
ID separator exception applies when final or only filter is ASCIIHex/ASCII85; encoded delimiter bytes remain data.
Amends alternate-image selection ordering and fallback; effective algorithm is source markup plus correction, not struck text.
ImageMask ignores its own Mask and ColorSpace; if SMaskInData is nonzero, explicit SMask is ignored. Does not waive BPC, Decode or channel conditions.
Uppercase I is the Table91 Interpolate key abbreviation; the same uppercase glyph I is Table92 Indexed value abbreviation, distinguished by key versus value position.
Marks image Name deprecated in PDF2.0.

assertions_and_consumers.feature: Table87 Decode cardinality/type and Table88 defaults
assertions: image_dictionary_consistency_audit.rs tests short/long RGB Decode arrays with incomplete/error outcome and valid six-number positive control.
decode_element_types_audit.rs::decode_pairs_must_each_be_numbers is current confirmed failure 2038-B11 for correct-length arrays with nonnumeric members.
decode_arrays.rs asserts linear mapping, omitted DeviceGray identity, reversed DeviceGray, Lab-specific default, every Indexed default index, and JPEG application.
jpx_decode_array.rs distinguishes stated ColorSpace applying Decode from absent-space JPX Decode being ignored.
assertions_and_consumers.consumer: pdf-model image dispatch/space and sample decoding, then CPU raster literal pixels in Decode tests.
assertions_and_consumers.quality: Independent sample/color expectations for covered rows; B11 is an observed failing assertion, not a new draft or inferred producer-only rejection.

assertions: image_masking_audit.rs::ec3_image_mask_ignores_its_own_mask_and_colour_space_entries checks marks/clear pixels with forbidden entries.
image_masking_audit.rs BPC=1 positive and BPC=2 diagnostic control.
image_masks.rs includes current-fill stencil pixels; explicit/color-key mask paths are owned by that sibling shard.
assertions_and_consumers.consumer: Image content interpretation into display list and CPU raster pixels.
assertions_and_consumers.quality: The #215 ignore rule is distinguished from malformed-input refusal; no defect identified in sampled stencil path.

assertions: rendering_intent.rs image-intent and graphics-state-default tests compare rendered transforms; image-mask intent branch is separately considered.
image_interpolation_audit.rs checks optional flag behavior under magnification; parent review says this is policy coverage, since processor may ignore interpolation.
assertions_and_consumers.consumer: Per-image state selection and image sampler.
assertions_and_consumers.quality: Intent tests are route-discriminating; interpolation pixels are not treated as a normative kernel oracle.

assertions: alternate_images_audit.rs compares black base/white alternate pixels for absent versus true DefaultForPrinting and reverses two visible alternates to show array order matters.
optional_content.rs covers hidden base/no alternate, visible base, first eligible alternative, selected alternate OC handling, and View/Print/Export distinctions.
assertions_and_consumers.consumer: Purpose-aware page interpretation and raster selection.
assertions_and_consumers.quality: The current selected branches are independent pixel consequences. Malformed duplicate DefaultForPrinting designation is producer-invalid; no reader refusal is inferred.

assertions: inline_images_dictionary_audit.rs tests full key positive control, abbreviation precedence in both key orders, unlisted SMask ignored, and key/value-position-sensitive uppercase I versus Indexed value.

inline_images_residual_audit.rs checks stencil with omitted ColorSpace and current color, DefaultGray versus named resource, LZW/A85 decoded bytes and resumed content, whitespace/sample preservation, reserved device names, and two literal Indexed palette colors.
inline_images.rs gives public render controls for abbreviated dictionaries and sample data.
assertions_and_consumers.consumer: Content-stream scanner → image dictionary decoder → display list → CPU raster; scan-only tests also assert exact data/suffix.
assertions_and_consumers.quality: Strong for selected abbreviation and byte-boundary paths. Table91 Intent correctly has no abbreviation; no missing RI key is implied. All table rows are not exhaustively tested.

assertions: jpx_ordinary_opacity_audit.rs has ordinary RGB code0 opaque control, code1 straight-alpha control, and code2 expected unpremultiplied result.
Current global expected-failures record code2 as 2038-B14 because the pinned JPX route refuses the valid sampled cdef opacity input before rasterization.
assertions_and_consumers.consumer: JPX filter/codestream channels through ordinary PDF image draw.
assertions_and_consumers.quality: B14 is retained as a confirmed, bounded current failure. Code0/1 controls pass; no second duplicate draft is proposed.

assertions_and_consumers.feature: Table87 trailing rows OC, AF, Measure and PtData (physical276/printed261)
assertions: optional_content.rs::a_hidden_base_image_shows_nothing_and_does_not_reach_its_alternates tests an image dictionary OC gate with a visible/hidden contrast; additional selected-alternate tests cover image OC and its amended priority rules.

pdf-model/src/attachment.rs unit test::an_images_associated_file_reads_back_through_the_general_reader checks that a synthetic image dictionary AF resolves to a name and /Source relationship through the generic helper. It is helper/carrier evidence, not host extraction or a valid whole-document producer witness: the synthetic tree is zero-page and the embedded file omits Table44 Params.
measurement.rs parses Measure and PtData for page Viewport records; selected measurement tests exercise viewport APIs, not Measure/PtData attached to image XObjects.
assertions_and_consumers.consumer: OC is on the image content interpretation/draw path; AF is generic association lookup; Measure/PtData are currently parsed in the viewport measurement path.
assertions_and_consumers.quality: OC has direct image visibility/skip pixel witnesses. AF helper behavior has a focused unit assertion but its fixture is not a fully conforming associated-file PDF. Measure/PtData are parsed for page Viewport records; no image-XObject-specific measurement consumer assertion was located. These are qualified coverage residuals, not automatic rendering defects.

ledger: doc/conformance/ledger.toml rows 8.9.5.1/.2/.3/.4, 8.9.6, 8.9.7, 7.4.9, 11.6.4.3/.5.2 are separate owners; this artifact maps selected Table87/88/89 and inline table cells without promoting a whole-row pass.

selected_adrs.assessment: Retain source split for Table87 image-mask ignores vs explicit error-on-inconsistent-image rule; B11 remains the narrow numeric-element failure.
Retain bounded sYCC/JPX channel route and literal pixels; this shard does not broaden JPX family coverage.
Current alternate-image path follows amended #79 OC precedence and separates Print from View/Export; prior pre-fix divergence is historical.
Inline separator/EOD choices are already covered in inline images shard; CRLF one-EOL vs single-separator interaction remains a source interpretation residual, not a red test.

limits: Selected dictionaries and consumer paths only. No claim of full filter/color-space, mask, transparency, codec or alternate malformed-input coverage.
B11 and B14 are already current global expected failures; no duplicate tests drafted.
Producer shall constraint is not converted to required reader rejection absent reader-directed source.
The Table88 matrix does not independently sample every color-space row; ICC Range and special spaces have sibling shards and remain outside this cell sample.
Inline fixtures use PDF1.7 exact-xref files; exact xref alone is not a producer-validity certificate, but the sampled cases state the local required image fields.

Table87 trailing Measure/PtData entries are included in the 23-key inventory; current measurement consumers found in this pass are viewport-oriented, so image-specific metadata semantics remain a bounded residual.
